verdict.rationale: Shopify CLI is well documented as an official command-line tool for generating and managing apps, themes, and headless storefronts, with clear commands (init, dev, deploy) and dev-store integration; it's also positioned as AI-aware via the AI Toolkit that connects AI coding tools to CLI store management. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party review specifically validating CLI usability for AI-native workflows.
